title: Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 3 cups sugar (you can reduce sugar if you like)
method: Put chillies and vinegar in a blender and puree.
Place the puree and all other ingredients in a heavy bottomed pan and simmer until sultanas and chillies are cooked and soft.
Allow to cool. Make a puree in a blender.
details: Category: Condiments, Jams, Preserves, Pickles and Sauces
